SELECT
    p.ProductName,
    li.total_on_hand,
    round(ds.avg_daily_sales, 4) AS avg_daily_sales_qty,
    round(li.total_on_hand / ds.avg_daily_sales, 2) AS days_coverage
FROM (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(OnHandQuantity) AS total_on_hand
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE DateKey = (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactInventory)
    GROUP BY ProductKey
) AS li
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-10-03')
      AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey
    HAVING avg_daily_sales > 0
) AS ds ON li.ProductKey = ds.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON li.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY days_coverage ASC
LIMIT 20
